subject: VPC: tiered on-prem discount safeguard & SLA routing details
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astramed.com>, procurement@astramed.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC: tiered on-prem discount safeguard & SLA routing details

Hi Liam / AstraMed procurement team,

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Attached is a revised pricing matrix and an initial SOW draft tailored to the on-prem/VPC option we discussed. High-level items here I wanted to put in writing: 

- Pricing approach: tiered node-commit discounts with a platform fee that can be amortized across the commit term. We built two protection mechanisms you asked about: a 6-month price protection window and a volume-based true-up.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours), Priority (24x7 response + named on-call), and Platinum (SLA-backed escalation with quarterly reviews).
- SLA routing: production traffic will route to the customer-dedicated pool, with automated fallback to a certified hosted variant in another region if capacity or hardware failures occur. Failover will be governed by routing policy in the SOW; we can lock the fallback to region or allow cross-region for lower latency risk.

Could you confirm whether the 6-month price protection is sufficient, or prefer a longer protection in exchange for a higher commit? Also, does AstraMed require hard guarantees for cross-region routing (e.g., avoid cross-border fallbacks for data residency reasons)?

Next step: if procurement is OK, we can issue an updated SOW with a firm commit and a draft order form for signature. I've attached: redwood_vpc_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (pricing scenarios) and SOW-AstraMed-draft-20260527.pdf.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: SOW-AstraMed-draft-20260527.pdf (pdf)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astramed.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@astramed.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T12:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: VPC: tiered on-prem discount safeguard & SLA routing details

Vanessa — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Price protection window: 6 months is a good starting point, but procurement will push for 12 months if we commit to a 24-month node guarantee. Is a 12-month protection possible if we increase the commit by ~20%?

2) Data residency / routing: for Prod workloads containing PHI, we cannot permit cross-border fallbacks. Any fallback must remain within US regions and use encrypted KV transfer. Is that something you can codify in the SOW?

3) Support & escalation: what are SLAs (response/acknowledge/resolve) per tier? We need clear on-call rotation details for Priority.

Can your team produce a version of the SOW that explicitly calls out the 12-month protection option and an exhibit for data-residency-limited routing? Procurement would like those boxes ticked before legal redlines.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Cloud Engineering — AstraMed
liam.oconnor@astramed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astramed.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@astramed.com, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC: tiered on-prem discount safeguard & SLA routing details

Hi Liam — jumping in with the technical clarifications you requested. Short answers below and notes on what I'll add to the SOW version.

- 12-month price protection: Commercial team supports offering a 12-month protection if AstraMed moves to a 24-month commit with the 20% uplift Vanessa mentioned. We'll include explicit language in the payment & pricing exhibit.

- Data-residency-limited fallback: we can add an Exhibit B that constrains fallback only to US-hosted Redwood Dedicated variants and blocks cross-border KV transfer. Fallback will still be automatic but restricted by region. We'll include encryption and audit logging requirements for any KV handover.

- Support SLAs (draft thresholds):
  * Standard: Acknowledge 8 business hours; target response 1 business day; no guaranteed uptime credit.
  * Priority: Acknowledge 1 hour; target response 4 hours; uptime credit begins at sustained outage > 30 minutes. Named on-call with escalation to our Platform Reliability SME.
  * Platinum: Acknowledge 15 mins; target response 60 mins; SLA-backed credits and monthly ops review.

I'll attach a redlined SOW snippet for the routing exhibit and the support SLA table. Vanessa — I'll shift the SOW to include the two commercial options (6-month and 12-month protection) and the region-limited fallback exhibit.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: SOW-exhibit-routing-and-sla-redline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astramed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, procurement@astramed.com
Date: 2026-05-28T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC: tiered on-prem discount safeguard & SLA routing details

Liam — appreciate the fast turnaround and clear asks. Quick summary & next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Commercial options: we'll build two final order forms — Option A (24-month commit with 6-month protection) and Option B (24-month commit + 20% uplift with 12-month protection). Expect both order forms in the updated SOW.

2) Routing & data residency: Marissa will embed Exhibit B restricting fallback to US-only Dedicated variants and include encryption/audit language. No cross-border fallbacks for PHI workloads.

3) SLA table: Marissa's thresholds are our starting point. Sean, can you confirm the on-call handover cadence and provide the named Platform Reliability SME contact for the SOW?

4) Sign-off cadence: procurement — if we can get informal sign-off on Option B by close of next week, legal can take the redline pass the week after and we aim for a July 1 ramp if the SOW is executed.

Attachments included: updated pricing matrix and the draft SOW (will have two exhibits). I'll follow up with a WebEx to walk procurement/legal through the redlines — proposed slot Thursday 10am PT.

If that all sounds OK, I'll circulate the new SOW.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
